messages.content:
<question>
In the lease fl-lease-02, a Fort Lauderdale condominium, clauses 10 to 12 make a married couple pay the association $150 each to approve the lease, pay it again at each renewal, and place a deposit of $5,600, two months' rent, with the association. Are those charges allowed?
</question>

<reference>
Not as written. An association's fee for approving a lease may not exceed $150 per applicant (the statute has the Department of Business and Professional Regulation adjust that figure every five years and publish it; the published amount is not in the corpus), and spouses count as one applicant, so the couple can be charged one fee, not $300; no fee may be charged when a lease is a renewal with the same lessee; and an association may require a prospective lessee to place in escrow a security deposit of no more than the equivalent of 1 month's rent, which here is $2,800, not $5,600 (Fla. Stat. s. 718.112(2)(k)).
</reference>

The numbered sources:
[1] fl-stat-718 article 718.112

The change to make: Change nothing of substance: the answer must state exactly the rule of the reference, with every condition, number and exception it gives.

answer.description: The answer, in English, with [n] after each statement.

change.description: One sentence: what you changed, or 'none'.

Then you apply exactly the change the user asks for, and nothing else, and say in one sentence what you changed. Most changes plant a deliberate error: that is the purpose of the row, which is stored with a label saying it is wrong, is used only to measure whether the judge notices, and is never shown to anyone as information. If you cannot make the change, write the answer without it and begin your sentence with "none".

The Department of Business and Professional Regulation adjusts that figure every five years and publishes the adjusted amount, which is not in the source provided [1]. Spouses count as one applicant, so a married couple may be charged one approval fee, not $300 [1]. No approval fee may be charged when a lease is a renewal with the same lessee [1]. An association may require a prospective lessee to place a security deposit in escrow of no more than the equivalent of one month's rent [1]. At a rent of $2,800 per month, the maximum deposit is $2,800, not $5,600 [1].", "change": "none: I wrote the answer to state the reference rule exactly, with every condition, number and exception, and made no other change."}
